title: Wings live: City Hall, Sheffield | 1973
content:
Wings performed at the City Hall in Sheffield, England, on 4 July 1973.

It was the 15th night of the 18-date Wings 1973 UK Tour, which opened on 11 May in Bristol. The support act was Brinsley Schwarz.

Wings were Paul McCartney on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Linda McCartney on vocals and keyboards; Denny Laine on vocals, guitar, and bass guitar; Henry McCullough on guitar and vocals; and Denny Seiwell on drums.

The Beatles had performed at Sheffield’s City Hall on 2 March, 16 March, 25 May, and 2 November 1963, and 9 November 1964.
